lines.en: I roll along and the ground rumbles.
My edges scrape the soil all the way.
I turn half a turn, then another.
I'm so heavy no one can push me.

lines.zh: 我压过的地方草都没了。
lines.en: No grass is left where I pass.
I roll on down the slope.
I leave a track where I roll.
I'm not the slightest bit hurried.
One of my faces presses down.
I go around a small stone.
I sit still on the ground.
My surface is rough and hard.
Grass grows in my seams.
I have no expression at all.
The ground sinks under me.
I lie perfectly still.
The lines across me run deep.
Insects crawl underneath me.
The sun falls on one of my corners.

lines.zh: 草从我的裂缝里长高了。
lines.en: The grass has grown tall in my cracks.
I'm so heavy even I feel lazy.
I don't plan to do anything.
You look small in front of me.

lines.zh: 我是一块搬不动的石头。
lines.en: I'm a stone that can't be moved.
Do you mean to shift me?

lines.zh: 你的工具在我身上会崩。
lines.en: Your tools will break on me.
Turning my body slowly, no hurry.
I weigh down this patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我是一块搬不动的石头，压着这片地。
lines.en: I am an immovable stone, pressing this ground.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也看得见你。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see you.
Give me one knock and see.
There's no door in me.
You're excessively near.
This bedrock cannot be broken.
Nothing passes here.
I leave no room at all.

lines.zh: 你想从我上面翻过去吗。
lines.en: Are you thinking of climbing over?
My edges will trip you up.
I stay here without moving.
And you can't pass either.
A small chip came off me.

lines.zh: 这一下震到了我的中心。
lines.en: That shook me to the core.
There's a crack at my corner.
This wound changes nothing.
I'm still weighing down this spot.
You knocked some chips loose.
I'm no lighter for it.
I slide slowly back into place.
I don't need that thing.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我压不到。
lines.en: What you hold, I cannot roll onto.
Holding it up does no good.
It means nothing to me.
I have no eyes to follow it.
Just set it on the ground.
It can't make me move.
You're trying to draw me off.
I won't shift aside.
I pay it no attention at all.
You struck me; I didn't move.
The shock sat you on the ground.
That made a very heavy sound.

lines.zh: 我的重量是你的几十倍。
lines.en: I weigh dozens of times what you do.
You pushed a long while to no effect.
Soil squeezes out from under me.
I sit without shifting at all.
Your hands must be all numb.
I shifted a very little.
That doesn't count as moving.
A rock needs no companion.
We're only two stones.
Lying side by side is enough.
Are you harder than I am?
Two stones resting together is enough.
Let's close this road together.
The wind passes between our seams.
We neither move nor tire.
Piled like this, we're solid.
No one will push us apart.
I've pressed it under me.
I can't see where it went.
It rolled under one of my edges.
I can't move to take it.
It's stopped beneath me.
I nudge it with one corner.
I roll over it and it crumbles to powder.
It won't stop me rolling over it.

lines.zh: 我是一块基岩，滚过去地面都在响。
lines.en: I am bedrock; rolling, I shake the ground.
I begin rolling your way.
I won't yield this stretch of road.
Backing off makes no difference.
I roll at you slowly.
Do you hear stone grinding?

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住你了，这块基岩砸下来。
lines.en: My shadow covers you; this bedrock comes down.
I have you blocked on this road.
I press in bit by bit.
You can't break this bedrock.
I've sealed this road.
Don't imagine you'll get past me.
I've rolled to the middle and stopped.
You're heading for the edge.
There's no gap over there either.
I roll across the ground toward you.
My edges scrape the soil open.
You've run to the left.
I turned to follow.

lines.zh: 我每一下都比上一下近。
lines.en: Each roll brings me nearer.
You went around that stone.
Nothing blocks my path.
You shot a glance back at me.
I crush dry branches all along the way.
I've crushed a few dead twigs.
You've backed toward the wall.
That won't hold me either.
I paused, then rolled on.
A bedrock block that won't break.
I'm about to bear down on you.
I've rolled up close to you.
I've blocked the crossing.
This is precisely that moment.
I roll over you whole.
You're squeezed against the wall.
That came with hundreds of pounds.
One shove sent you sliding.
Your armor got crushed out of shape.
Soil squeezed out around us.
You stepped back two paces, gasping.
I slowly line myself up again.
I left you some room there.
You grabbed at my edge.
One slight turn shook you off.
All you have left is breathing.
I rolled a little further.
Can you still get up?
I won't be gentle this time.
I rose up out of the ground.
The ground caved in around me.
I pressed out a deep pit.
Grass is crushed beneath me.
I settled down bit by bit.
I'm blocking it right in the middle.
Clods of earth roll off me.
I make no movement.
I slowly turn that way.
My shadow is long and broad.
Ash settles on me from the wind.
I stay there and wait.
The footsteps are coming closer.
I'm ready to roll forward.
This road only fits one.
I've blocked this end.
The shaking carries a long way.
Now let me come through.
Fire has my surface hot.
I came down and the ground sank.

lines.zh: 水进不去，只是把我泡湿。
lines.en: The water can't get in; it only wets me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震得抬了一下。
lines.en: The blast jolted me up slightly.
The arrowhead broke against me.
That force can't pass through me.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，火星四溅。
lines.en: Lightning struck and sparks flew.
I'm falling, heavily.
